source_finding.diagnosis: The ordinary-source enumerable-only key snapshot includes colors. depth's live getter deletes that slot. The old ordinary path does not recheck its descriptor, so it reads undefined and overwrites the existing target default. A previous getter can also make an initially nonenumerable key enumerable; retaining only initial enumerable keys cannot implement that case.

standards.finding: Snapshot every own key for each source. For each key, read its current own descriptor; only a present enumerable property is read and assigned through the target's actual Set operation.
Snapshot every own key, apply the exclusion list before observing its current descriptor, then read and create the result's own data property only when that descriptor is present and enumerable.
